negative_snippets:
The Receptionist is very rude. My family and I had booked a room at your hotel through Goibibo, and upon arrival, we were shocked to find that our confirmed booking was canceled by the receptionist. He stated that the price shown on Goibibo was low and demanded additional charges from my end.
Not only was this completely unfair and unprofessional, but the receptionist also spoke to me in an extremely rude and aggressive manner. Such behavior is unacceptable, especially in the hospitality industry where courtesy and professionalism are expected at all times.
